name: Ikenai Katsumi Sensei ~Kanja-san Oita wa Dame Yon~
original_name: いけないかつみ先生 ～患者さんおいたはだめよん～
source:
Katsumi-sensei from D.P.S. series is back! Her goal to seduce patients remains intact, but now with a lot of bizarre events happening to her!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
D.P.S.系列的Katsumi老师回来了！她勾引患者的目标依然没变，只是这一次，还有许多稀奇古怪的事件接连发生在她身上！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
